meta.title: Salesforce Developer
meta.tagline: Build custom solutions on the Salesforce platform.
meta.description: Salesforce developers build custom applications, integrations and automations on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Web Components and declarative tools.

details.description: Salesforce developers build custom applications, integrations and automations on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Web Components and declarative tools.
details.whyLearn: Build custom solutions on the Salesforce platform. Salesforce developers build custom applications, integrations and automations on the Salesforce platform using Apex, Lightning Web Components and declarative tools.
objectives: Build a complete foundation in salesforce developer
Complete hands-on projects for your portfolio

Build and publish projects at every stage
Join communities and network
